ops.title: project — capt-hook 9.22.0 generalized marketplace self-bootstrap to any consumer-declared dependency; getaway now one-line install
ops.body:
capt-hook `pack attach` self-bootstrap generalized from the hardcoded captain-hook marketplace to **any** dependency marketplace a consumer pack declares. `capt-hook.toml` gains `marketplaces = ["owner/repo", ...]`; attach registers each unknown one (captain-hook implicit) via `claude plugin marketplace add`, and CC auto-resolves the `plugin.json` cross-marketplace deps (no explicit `plugin install` — dropped, relies on CC ≥2.1.117; also fixed a 9.15.0 install-hang).

- **Phase 1** shipped in released **9.21.0** (commit `60b57a32`) — rode a concurrent session's tag (9.16–9.21 burned mid-work).
- Codex review lane was down (quota + agent type withdrawn) → escalated to **two fable reviews**; found 8 correctness + 2 security items, all fixed in `5ca4290b`. The four MED ones matter: git/local-source marketplaces now count as known (killed an **hourly re-add loop**); per-repo error isolation; **non-blocking attach lock** (no SessionStart stall on the worker); **per-(config-dir,repo) markers** (cc-pool multi-config stopped cross-damping). Known-check is now source.repo (github) + source.url (git) + basename-name fallback (local).
- Docs `c246abbd`; released **9.22.0** (`c0277f55` + tag `v9.22.0`, wheel-verified).
- **getaway** `f1f91d6`: `marketplaces = ["yasyf/cc-present"]` + both README install blocks → one `/plugin marketplace add yasyf/getaway` line; `pack lint` 7/7 green. Live multi-marketplace smoke: notice names both repos, worker runs marketplace-add per repo, 2 markers, no install.
- Residual: cc-present's own README still says "add captain-hook marketplace first" (obsolete since 9.15.0) — independent follow-up, not done.

Builds on the 9.15.0 wave ([[review-db-real-path]] era). See cc-notes note `bd6f72f`. The first wave (captain-hook-only self-bootstrap + `pack scaffold`) shipped 9.15.0.
